Name: Consumer-grade EEG device evaluation
Description: This dataset includes EEG data for multiple experimental conditions (EB, BT, MVO, MVC). Each condition contains event-related information (onset, duration, event type, and latency) in the corresponding .mat files located in the derivatives folder.

Events.Description: The events for each condition (EB, BT, MVO, MVC) are stored in separate structures within the .mat files (e.g., 'EB.event', 'BT.event', 'MVO.event', 'MVC.event'). Each structure contains the following fields: 'edftype' (event type), 'latency' (event onset time in seconds), and 'srate' (sampling rate).

Structure.latency: Latency of the event in seconds (relative to the start of the recording)

Events.Location: The .mat files for each subject (e.g., 'sub-01_acq-BLP-eeg.mat') contain event information for each condition (EB, BT, MVO, MVC) in the respective 'EB.event', 'BT.event', 'MVO.event', and 'MVC.event' structures.
